NSCameraUsageDescription: Reiz uses the camera to post your progress and your profile photo.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Reiz accesses your photo library to post your progress (photo or video) and your profile photo.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Reiz saves the photo or video you just took to your library, only when you tap “Save”.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Reiz uses the microphone to record the sound of your progress videos.
NSContactsUsageDescription: Reiz looks at your contacts to tell you which ones are already on the app and let you invite the others. Your contacts are never saved by Reiz.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Reiz only uses your location to detect when you arrive at a training place you chose (your gym, your field) and notify your close circle. Your coordinates stay on your phone and are never sent.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Reiz only uses your location to detect when you arrive at a training place you chose (your gym, your field) and notify your close circle. Your coordinates stay on your phone and are never sent.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Reiz reads your location when you save a training place (your gym, your field). It stays on your phone.
